title: Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert
overview: If you’re an administrator who deploys and manages Microsoft 365 and performs Microsoft 365 tenant-level implementation and administration of cloud and hybrid environments, this certification is designed for you.
eligibility: None strictly required. Prior knowledge of Microsoft cloud technologies recommended.
exam_format_type: Multiple choice, case studies, and performance-based labs
testing_method: Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored
